scientific.integrity: The source definitions imply an exact mass balance identity: actual weighted gradient norms sum to \(T\bar G\), while the powered targets sum to \(T\bar G M_\alpha\). The sharp lower bound follows from the triangle inequality, explicit positive allocations attain equality, and strict Jensen inequalities classify heterogeneous rates.
limitations: Instantaneous target-compatibility result rather than a training-convergence theorem.
Sharp attainability assumes positive task gradient magnitudes and positive task weights.
The mean-renormalized target is an algebraic repair; no empirical superiority is claimed.

title: GradNorm's powered-rate targets are self-consistent only at unit asymmetry
